public_safety_rules: Do not include private reviewer identity unless permission is granted.
Do not include private holdout manifests, task IDs, private routes, private seeds, raw private outputs, captures, credentials, or local absolute paths.
Replace embedded unresolved markers such as TBD, TODO, pending, unknown, n/a, and angle-bracket placeholders with concrete review facts.
An unresolved decision keeps its lane pending and cannot satisfy strict completion.
Accepted findings require committed post-review remediation and final source review; a pre-existing file is not remediation evidence.
All three formal lanes and the separate SaaS/product-security lane must bind to one frozen reviewed commit whose mandatory source trees match the current candidate.
